- `afterSession` runs even though the session never started, and it receives no signal saying so: it is handed the same session on every path. A hook that releases what `beforeSession` allocated must therefore tolerate a release of something never allocated, for example by recording the allocation on its own state and releasing only what it recorded; `onError` firing before it is the only cue that the turn failed, and it does not say at which stage.
'''

open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

'''
